name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's conversational AI assistant powered by the GPT-5.5 model family (GPT-5.5 Instant is the universal default since 2026-05-05; GPT-5.5 Thinking and Pro on paid tiers), offering text generation, code assistance, image generation, file analysis, and web browsing through a chat interface. GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 were retired from ChatGPT on 2026-02-13.

writing-chat.summary: ChatGPT's core capability, providing conversational text generation with Canvas for collaborative editing, custom instructions for persistent preferences, and system-level prompt customization.

subFeatures.name: Canvas
subFeatures.description: Side-by-side collaborative editing workspace for writing and code, supporting inline suggestions, adjusting reading level, length, and adding polish or emojis

subFeatures.name: Custom Instructions
subFeatures.description: Persistent user-defined instructions applied automatically to all new conversations, covering response style and background context

subFeatures.name: Multi-turn Conversations
subFeatures.description: Full conversation history within a thread with ability to edit and regenerate previous messages

subFeatures.name: Markdown Rendering
subFeatures.description: Rich text output with code blocks, tables, LaTeX math, and structured formatting

subFeatures.name: Model Selection
subFeatures.description: Users can switch between GPT-5.5 Instant (default), GPT-5.5 Thinking, and GPT-5.5 Pro within a conversation; GPT-5.4 Thinking/Pro remain selectable on paid tiers. GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and o-series models were retired from ChatGPT on 2026-02-13

limitations: GPT-5.5 context window is 1M tokens via the API; the ChatGPT product applies conversation-management limits below the raw model maximum
GPT-5.5 Thinking and Pro variants are paid-tier only (Free uses GPT-5.5 Instant)
Canvas not available on free tier
System prompt customization only available via API, not ChatGPT UI

pricingTiers.details: GPT-5.5 Instant default, basic chat features, limited usage
More messages and uploads than Free; sits between Free and Plus; no Agent mode or data connectors
GPT-5.5 Instant/Thinking/Pro and GPT-5.4 variants, Canvas, higher rate limits
5x Plus usage, GPT-5.5 Pro, ChatGPT Pulse, higher Codex usage
20x Plus usage, highest-usage option
Team plan with admin console, workspace management, higher limits
Highest limits, advanced admin, SSO/SCIM, audit logs, dedicated capacity

versionHistory.changes: Became the universal default model for all ChatGPT users; 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims vs GPT-5.3 Instant on high-stakes prompts; 1M-token context in API
GPT-5.5 family launched (Instant, Thinking, Pro); GA in API 2026-04-24
Thinking and Pro variants; remains available to paid users
GPT-5.3 Instant was the prior default; remains available to paid users before retirement
GPT-5 generation (Instant and Thinking); both retired from ChatGPT on 2026-02-13
Improved instruction following, long-context up to 1M tokens via API; retired from ChatGPT 2026-02-13
Natively multimodal model with vision and faster responses, 128K context; retired from ChatGPT 2026-02-13

research.summary: ChatGPT can browse the web in real time to find current information, cite sources with links, and perform multi-step research with the Deep Research feature.

subFeatures.name: Web Browsing
subFeatures.description: Real-time web search integrated into conversations, providing cited responses with source links

subFeatures.name: Deep Research
subFeatures.description: Multi-step autonomous research that synthesizes information from dozens of sources into a comprehensive report

subFeatures.name: Source Citations
subFeatures.description: Inline citations with clickable links to original sources in browsing-enabled responses

limitations: Web browsing may not access paywalled or login-gated content
Deep Research has limited daily uses even on Plus tier
Cannot guarantee real-time accuracy of rapidly changing information
Browsing results depend on search engine indexing

pricingTiers.details: Basic web browsing with limited usage
Full web browsing, Deep Research with limited monthly uses
Higher Deep Research limits, priority access

versionHistory.changes: Autonomous multi-step research agent producing comprehensive reports
Web browsing re-enabled for all Plus users after initial beta

file-analysis.summary: ChatGPT can upload, read, and analyze files including PDFs, spreadsheets, images, and code files through Advanced Data Analysis (formerly Code Interpreter) with a sandboxed Python environment.

subFeatures.name: Advanced Data Analysis
subFeatures.description: Sandboxed Python environment that can process uploaded files, run computations, generate charts, and perform statistical analysis

subFeatures.name: Image Understanding
subFeatures.description: Analyze uploaded images including charts, diagrams, screenshots, handwritten text, and photos using GPT-5.5 multimodal vision

subFeatures.name: Document Parsing
subFeatures.description: Read and extract content from PDFs, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, CSV files, and text files

subFeatures.name: Code File Analysis
subFeatures.description: Read, explain, debug, and refactor uploaded code files in any major programming language

limitations: File upload limited to 512 MB per file
Advanced Data Analysis sandbox has no internet access
Python environment has limited library availability
Cannot process password-protected or encrypted files
Image analysis may struggle with very small text or complex diagrams

pricingTiers.details: Basic file uploads and image analysis, limited Advanced Data Analysis
Full Advanced Data Analysis with higher usage limits
Highest usage limits, data retention controls

versionHistory.changes: Rebranded from Code Interpreter, integrated with GPT-4o vision
Sandboxed Python execution environment for data analysis
Support for uploading and analyzing multiple file types

document-creation.summary: ChatGPT can generate structured documents, reports, and formatted content through Canvas's collaborative editing environment and Advanced Data Analysis for data-driven outputs.

subFeatures.name: Canvas Document Editing
subFeatures.description: Full-featured writing workspace with inline editing, tone adjustment, length control, and reading level modification

subFeatures.name: Chart and Visualization Generation
subFeatures.description: Create charts, graphs, and data visualizations via Advanced Data Analysis Python environment

subFeatures.name: Formatted Text Output
subFeatures.description: Generate markdown, structured documents, tables, and formatted content directly in chat

limitations: No native export to Word, PDF, or Google Docs from Canvas
Canvas documents are not shareable as standalone links
Chart generation requires Advanced Data Analysis (Python-based, not interactive)
Cannot create presentations or slide decks natively

pricingTiers.details: Basic text generation in chat, no Canvas
Canvas document editing, chart generation via ADA
Full feature access with admin controls

versionHistory.changes: Collaborative editing workspace for documents and code
Python-based chart and document generation

image-generation.summary: ChatGPT generates images via ChatGPT Images 2.0 (released 2026-04-21), available on all tiers including Free, with editing capabilities and style controls. The earlier DALL-E 3 model is being phased out.

subFeatures.name: ChatGPT Images 2.0
subFeatures.description: Current image generation model (released 2026-04-21), available on all tiers including Free in Instant mode; produces high-quality images with strong prompt following and text rendering

subFeatures.name: Thinking Image Generation
subFeatures.description: Self-verifying, batched image generation that can search during generation for higher-fidelity results

subFeatures.name: Image Editing
subFeatures.description: Modify specific regions of generated images through conversational follow-up instructions

subFeatures.name: Style Presets
subFeatures.description: Generate images in various artistic styles including photorealistic, illustration, and artistic renderings

limitations: Cannot generate images of real public figures by policy
No precise spatial layout control — prompt-dependent results
Image editing capabilities limited compared to dedicated tools like Photoshop
Thinking (self-verifying) image generation is limited to paid tiers; Free uses Instant mode only

pricingTiers.details: ChatGPT Images 2.0 in Instant mode with usage limits
ChatGPT Images 2.0 with Thinking image generation, higher limits
Higher generation limits, content policy customization options

versionHistory.changes: New image generation model available on all tiers incl. Free; Thinking (self-verifying) mode on paid tiers
Native image generation from GPT-4o with better text rendering and consistency
Major quality upgrade with better prompt adherence; being phased out as of 2026

prototyping.summary: ChatGPT supports code prototyping through Canvas's code editing mode and Advanced Data Analysis, enabling users to write, run, and iterate on code in Python and generate HTML/CSS/JS previews.

subFeatures.name: Canvas Code Editor
subFeatures.description: Dedicated code editing workspace with syntax highlighting, inline comments, bug fixing, and port-to-language features

subFeatures.name: Python Code Execution
subFeatures.description: Run Python code in a sandboxed environment via Advanced Data Analysis, producing visual outputs and file downloads

subFeatures.name: HTML/CSS/JS Preview
subFeatures.description: Generate front-end code that can be copied and previewed locally, though no in-browser preview is provided

limitations: Code execution limited to Python only (no JavaScript, Ruby, etc.)
No live preview for HTML/CSS/JS within ChatGPT interface
Sandbox environment has no network access or persistent storage
Cannot connect to external databases or APIs from code sandbox
Canvas code mode limited to single-file editing

pricingTiers.details: Basic code generation in chat, no Canvas or code execution
Canvas code editing, Advanced Data Analysis with Python execution
Full access with higher execution limits

versionHistory.changes: Collaborative code editing workspace with language detection and debugging
Sandboxed Python execution for code prototyping

personalization.summary: ChatGPT offers Custom Instructions and Memory features that adapt responses to individual users' preferences, background, and communication style across conversations.

subFeatures.name: Custom Instructions
subFeatures.description: Two-field system for telling ChatGPT about yourself and how you want responses formatted, applied to all new conversations

subFeatures.name: Memory
subFeatures.description: ChatGPT remembers key facts and preferences across conversations, building a persistent user profile that can be viewed and edited

subFeatures.name: Custom GPTs
subFeatures.description: User-created specialized chatbots with custom instructions, knowledge files, and configured actions for specific use cases

limitations: Memory can only be managed manually — users cannot bulk-import preferences
Custom Instructions limited to two text fields with character limits
Custom GPTs require Plus subscription to create (free users can only use public ones)
Memory feature not available in all regions

pricingTiers.details: Custom Instructions only
Custom Instructions, Memory, create and use Custom GPTs
All personalization features, admin-managed GPTs, no data training

versionHistory.changes: Persistent cross-conversation memory with user controls
User-created specialized assistants with GPT Store
Persistent instructions applied to all conversations

persistent-context.summary: ChatGPT maintains context through conversation history, Memory across sessions, and Custom GPTs with uploaded knowledge bases for domain-specific persistence.

subFeatures.name: Conversation History
subFeatures.description: All conversations are saved and searchable, with ability to resume previous threads

subFeatures.name: Memory System
subFeatures.description: Cross-conversation memory that persists user facts, preferences, and project context across all new conversations

subFeatures.name: Custom GPT Knowledge
subFeatures.description: Upload documents to Custom GPTs as persistent knowledge bases available in every conversation with that GPT

limitations: No native project or workspace organization for conversations
Memory has limited capacity and may not retain all details
Custom GPT knowledge files have upload size limits
No shared team knowledge base in Team tier (per-GPT only)
Conversation search is basic text matching, not semantic

pricingTiers.details: Conversation history only
History, Memory, Custom GPT knowledge bases
All features with admin-managed knowledge and data controls

versionHistory.changes: Cross-conversation persistent memory
File uploads as persistent knowledge for Custom GPTs
Saved conversation history with ChatGPT launch

agents.summary: ChatGPT supports agentic capabilities through the unified ChatGPT agent (a virtual browser, code interpreter, terminal, and file handling), Custom GPTs with Actions (API integrations), and Deep Research for autonomous multi-step investigation. The former Operator product was merged into ChatGPT agent.

subFeatures.name: ChatGPT agent
subFeatures.description: Unified agent (formerly Operator) with a virtual browser, code interpreter, terminal, and file handling that can navigate websites and perform multi-step tasks autonomously

subFeatures.name: Custom GPT Actions
subFeatures.description: Connect Custom GPTs to external APIs via OpenAPI schemas, enabling them to take actions like sending emails, querying databases, or updating records

subFeatures.name: Deep Research Agent
subFeatures.description: Autonomous research agent that browses multiple sources, synthesizes findings, and produces comprehensive reports

limitations: ChatGPT agent has per-tier monthly message caps: Plus 40 messages/month, Pro 400 messages/month (not unlimited)
ChatGPT agent is not available on Free or Go tiers
Custom GPT Actions require technical setup with OpenAPI specifications
Deep Research limited to information gathering, cannot take external actions
On Enterprise/Edu the agent is off by default and admin-gated

pricingTiers.details: No ChatGPT agent
ChatGPT agent (40 messages/month), Custom GPT Actions, Deep Research
ChatGPT agent (400 messages/month), Custom GPT Actions, full Deep Research
ChatGPT agent admin-gated (off by default), Custom GPT Actions with enterprise API integrations

versionHistory.changes: Unified agent merging Operator with a virtual browser, code interpreter, terminal, and file handling
Browser-based autonomous task agent (later merged into ChatGPT agent)
Multi-step autonomous research with source synthesis

connectors.summary: ChatGPT connects to external services through Custom GPT Actions (API-based), native integrations with services like Google Drive and OneDrive, and the now-deprecated plugin ecosystem.

subFeatures.name: Custom GPT Actions
subFeatures.description: OpenAPI-based integration framework allowing GPTs to call external APIs for reading and writing data to third-party services

subFeatures.name: Native File Integrations
subFeatures.description: Direct integration with Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, and other cloud storage for file access within conversations

subFeatures.name: GPT Store
subFeatures.description: Marketplace of pre-built GPTs with various third-party integrations, searchable by category and use case

limitations: Plugin ecosystem deprecated in favor of Custom GPT Actions
No native integration with Slack, Notion, or project management tools in ChatGPT UI
Actions require technical expertise to configure OpenAPI specs
Third-party GPTs in the store have variable quality and reliability
Enterprise connectors require custom setup

pricingTiers.details: Use public GPTs from the store
Create GPTs with Actions, access GPT Store, cloud file integration
Admin-managed integrations, SSO-protected GPTs

versionHistory.changes: Google Drive and OneDrive integration for file access
Marketplace for discovering and sharing Custom GPTs
Plugin ecosystem wound down in favor of GPT Actions

subFeatures.description: Real-time speech-to-speech conversation with natural-sounding voices, emotional expression, and the ability to interrupt mid-response

subFeatures.name: Voice Input (Whisper)
subFeatures.description: Speech-to-text input using OpenAI Whisper transcription, available on mobile and desktop apps for dictating prompts

subFeatures.name: Voice Selection
subFeatures.description: Choose from multiple voice personas for ChatGPT responses in voice mode

limitations: Advanced Voice Mode not available on free tier
Voice mode has shorter context handling than text mode
Cannot share voice conversations or export audio
Voice mode not available in all countries
Standard voice input requires mobile or desktop app (not available in web browser)

pricingTiers.details: Basic voice input via Whisper on mobile app
Advanced Voice Mode with multiple voices, real-time conversation
Advanced Voice Mode with admin controls
